translate_en|mods/TrueMusicRadio/42.16/m: Terminal
True Music Radio
Enable True Music MTV Channel
Enabling this will allow the creation of the True Music MTV channel. (Optional as it can interfere with some other TV Channel mods.)
Allow Skip On Server
Enabling this will allow players to skip a song on the radio by clicking the tune in button like in single player. (not suggested in case of players spamming the server, admins can already do this)
True Music Radio Station 1 Frequency
The frequency for the 1st True Music Radio station. (Default 92FM = 92000)
True Music Radio Station 2 Frequency
The frequency for the 2nd True Music Radio station. (Default 92.2FM = 92200)
True Music Radio Station 3 Frequency
The frequency for the 3rd True Music Radio station. (Default 92.4FM = 92400)
True Music Radio Station 4 Frequency
The frequency for the 4th True Music Radio station. (Default 92.6FM = 92600)
True Music Radio Station 5 Frequency
The frequency for the 5th True Music Radio station. (Default 92.8FM = 92800)
Exclude Holiday Songs
Enabling this will exclude only the holiday songs added by the TCCacheMP prerequisite mod from playing on the radio stations unless the media is added to the terminals.
Exclude TCCacheMP Songs
Enabling this will exclude the songs added by the TCCacheMP prerequisite mod from playing on the radio stations unless the media is added to the terminals.
Exclude Vanilla Theme Songs
Enabling this will exclude the vanilla theme songs from playing on the radio stations unless the media is added to the terminals.
True Music MTV
The frequency for the True Music MTV Station. (Default: 211)
How Much Music Spawns In The True Music Radio Station Terminals
Very Low
Low
Medium
High
Random
None
How much music media spawns in the station terminals.
Enable True Music Radio Stations Horde Night Announcements
Enabling this will add warning announcements when Horde Night starts. (Only if the Horde Night mod is enabled)
Enable True Music Radio Mood Bonuses
Enabling this will give the player a bonus to happiness and boredom when music is played nearby.
Enable True Music Radio Stations Song Announcements
Enabling this will add song announcements when new songs start.
Enable True Music Radio Stations Weather Broadcasts
Enabling this will add weather broadcasting on the hour.
Enable True Music Radios To Attract Zombies
Enabling this will increase the possibility of zombies being attracted to True Music Radio music. (Does not affect vanilla radio attraction.)
Enable The True Music Radio Station Terminal To Eject Additional Music
Enabling this will allow the west station terminal to eject additional media. (Amounts based on filled amount settings)
Eject music from terminal library:
Revert the radio playlist back to the entire True Music library
I am unable to access this Terminal, the path is blocked.
I will need a generator nearby to power it.
Update radio playlist from terminal library
Enable Alternate Stereo 3D Audio For True Music Radio (Experimental)
This experimental option creates a simulated 3D audio in stereo for True Music Radio when standard 3D audio is disabled.
Enable RDS On True Music Radio Stations
Enable Song Announcement On True Music Radio Stations
Enable this option to activate song announcements on True Music Radio stations. (Only deactivates announcements in single player games.)
Enable this option to activate the Radio Data System for music information on True Music Radio stations.
Mute All True Music Radios
Enable this option to mute all True Music Radio songs in the game.
Stop Playing All True Music Radios
Enable this option to stop all True Music Radio music from playing in the game. It removes the stutter but disconnects the sync with music on the server.
Enable The Blacklist System In Terminals (will cause a lag spike on terminals)
This will enable the blacklist system in the terminals setup for music stations but with large music lists can cause lag pulling the song list.
Enable The Eject Media System In Terminals (will cause a lag spike on terminals)
This will enable the eject media system in the terminals setup for music stations but with large music lists can cause lag pulling the song list.
Disable All True Music Radio 3D Audio
This option forces all True Music Radios to lose 3D audio.
Adjust True Music Radio Volume
This will adjust the play volume of the music from radios beyond the radio volume bar.
